links.outcome: Alignment with and grounding in clinical guidelines, and treatment/investigation preciseness, versus PCPs
links.effect: AMIE, using in-context retrieval over guidelines and drug formularies, was non-inferior to 21 PCPs in management reasoning and scored better on preciseness of treatment and investigation and on guideline alignment and grounding.
links.quote: AMIE was non-inferior to PCPs in management reasoning, as assessed by specialists, and scored better both with respect to preciseness of treatment and investigation, and in terms of its alignment with and grounding in clinical guidelines.

unlisted_practices: Agentic multivisit management dialogue system combining long-context retrieval with structured reasoning
RxQA formulary-derived multiple-choice benchmark validated by pharmacists for medication reasoning

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of AMIE (a conversational LLM agent) using virtual OSCEs with simulated cases compared against primary care physicians, as well as benchmark testing on RxQA.
